name: Root
description: Asymmetric woodland strategy by Leder Games. First faction to 30 wins.

setupSteps.label: Map
setupSteps.description: Each map changes how clearings link and a few global rules.

options.label: Autumn
options.description: The default map. No special rules.

options.label: Winter
options.description: A Raging River divides forests, adding a forest-traversal barrier.

options.label: Lake
options.description: A central lake links coastal clearings; a ferry shuttles between them.

options.label: Mountain
options.description: Closed paths must be opened by spending cards; ruling the central Pass scores.

options.label: Marsh
options.description: Flood markers seal off clearings; flooded paths enclose forests.

options.label: Gorge
options.description: A dam separates forests; a bridge crosses without splitting them.

setupSteps.label: Deck
setupSteps.description: Swap the card mix for variety.

setupSteps.label: Landmarks
setupSteps.description: Map-side scoring perks. Place 0–2 landmark cards.

setupSteps.label: Hirelings
setupSteps.description: Bot-driven allies. Take on up to 3.

setupSteps.label: Draft factions
setupSteps.description: Players choose factions from a shared pool in counterclockwise order.

setupSteps.label: Faction
setupSteps.description: Each player claims one faction. The Vagabond and Knaves of the Deepwood cannot both be in the same game.

options.label: Marquise de Cat
options.description: Industrial cats building sawmills, workshops, and recruiters across the wood.

options.label: Eyrie Dynasties
options.description: Bird aristocracy bound by a Decree. Falls into turmoil if it can't act.

options.label: Woodland Alliance
options.description: Forest revolutionaries spreading sympathy and igniting open revolt.

options.label: Vagabond
options.description: Solo wanderer with a satchel of items, completing quests and aiding (or sabotaging) other factions.

options.label: Lizard Cult
options.description: Outcast lizards turning discarded cards into gardens and revealed-suit rituals.

options.label: Riverfolk Company
options.description: Otter mercantilists selling services, mercenaries, and dividend funds along the river.

options.label: Underground Duchy
options.description: Mole monarchy tunnelling from the Burrow, swaying Ministers to expand its actions.

options.label: Corvid Conspiracy
options.description: Crow plotters laying secret tokens that punish meddling rivals.

options.label: Lord of the Hundreds
options.description: Warlord rats riding mood swings into burning, occupying, and humiliating their neighbours.

options.label: Keepers in Iron
options.description: Knightly badgers recovering and protecting lost relics, scoring through guarded prestige.

options.label: Lilypad Diaspora
options.description: Frog newcomers seeking a peaceful Woodland home — but quick to harden under pressure.

options.label: Twilight Council
options.description: Diplomats convening assemblies to redirect the woodland from violence to negotiation.

options.label: Knaves of the Deepwood
options.description: Forest miscreants raiding warriors and ransoming hostages back for victory.
